Alex Chen: pushed changes for PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2345 — addressed the inline comments, moved the retry/backoff logic into backoff/util.py and added a focused unit and a small smoke. PTAL when you have a sec.
Riley K: quick glance — left one small naming nit (max_retries -> retry_limit) otherwise looks solid.
Alex Chen: good catch, renamed and force-pushed. also added the tiny unit test to cover 504 path.
Alex Chen: ```python
def test_backoff_504():
    assert backoff_delay(504) == pytest.approx(0.5, rel=1e-2)
```
Tara S: can you drop the smoke output here? want to eyeball p95 before we schedule a canary.
Alex Chen: smoke run snippet: `smoke: 12/12 passed; p50 45ms; p95 120ms; errors 0/12` — full log uploaded to the PR artifacts.
codecov-bot: report: coverage decreased by 0.18% on runtime/backoff/util.py (files changed).
Alex Chen: added an extra assertion in test to cover the edge branch — should bump coverage back up, re-running.
Riley K: thanks — I can approve once CI is green. :+1:
Tara S: I'm OOO until 1pm but can approve after lunch if still needed.
ci-bot: linux build passed; integration suite queued (expected ~10m).
Alex Chen: re-requesting eyes: PTAL @Riley K @Tara S — aiming to merge before tomorrow's canary window.
Riley K: will take a final look in ~5 and approve if green.
codecov-bot: after update: coverage delta now +0.05%.
Alex Chen: awesome, thanks. plan: merge after 2 approvals and green integration; will ping ops for canary slot.
Tara S: noted — thanks for the quick turnaround.
Alex Chen: done — thanks all :rocket:
